text: The N=128-to-N=256 force-margin decline is mostly trained R2 on data_seed 0, seeds 24-26: 54-75% of the margin loss. On data_seed 1, seeds 20-21, it is entirely control: trained R2 is flat at about 0.66-0.67 while controls rise from 0.52 to 0.60-0.63. Is the decomposition of that step set by the dataset rather than by the model seed? Would N=128 and N=256 runs of seeds 22-23 on data_seed 1 reproduce the control-dominated pattern?
